about: Kinton Aerospace's jet. Concept data for the build-along. Every figure is for our own jet, not the model in general. Photo alt text describes what each file should show: update it if your photo differs.

pricing.estimateBasis: One way, or a return on the same day. Both are two flights: yours and the jet's flight back to Barcelona, empty or with you on board.

rows.label: Operator
rows.value: Kinton Aerospace, with our own crew

zones.label: Cockpit
zones.text: Two of our own pilots on every flight.

zones.label: Entry
zones.text: The door is at the front, on the left. Opposite it, one seat faces the aisle.

zones.label: Club seats
zones.text: Four seats in two facing pairs, each pair with a fold-out table.

zones.label: Forward seats
zones.text: Two seats facing forward, behind the club seats.

zones.label: Washroom
zones.text: A private washroom at the back of the cabin.

zones.label: Luggage hold
zones.text: In the tail, with room for a suitcase per passenger.
